name: "Smoky God"
source:
A mysterious, rich, but eccentric celebrity and a member of the Invaders, as well as the World Representative of the land of Shangri La.

His true identity is Siddhartha, the Buddha who strived for the enlightenment and freeing all from the suffering, in the process casting away all the bonds he had once shared with those he loves. However, he himself ultimately couldn't cast away the bond of his dearest friend Asura who rejected the way of the world and chose to live forever in the cycle of strives and reincarnations.
